# Morpheus MyProvider — full agent recipe (llms-full)

> Goal: from zero to a healthy Morpheus provider bid using myprovider.mor.org + nodedocs + active.mor.org.
> Secrets entered in the GUI are session-only (browser memory) or a local JSON file you save — nothing is uploaded to myprovider.mor.org.

Last aligned: SecretVM node-first flow (wallet → deploy → register → models/bids), MOR/hour, Venice per-bid with model picker + key reuse, GitHub digest-pinned compose.

---

## What this product is

**MyProvider** (https://myprovider.mor.org) is a static web app that helps craft proxy-router / SecretVM secrets, connects to **your** running proxy-router over HTTP Basic Auth, then registers the provider and bids on models.

**Deeper docs:** https://nodedocs.mor.org/llms-full.txt · MCP https://nodedocs.mor.org/mcp

---

## Critical: two different “model names”

| Field | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `modelId` | Morpheus on-chain Id (active.mor.org) |
| Marketplace `Name` | Human label on chain |
| Config `modelName` | **Backend** string sent as OpenAI `model` (Venice id or local name) |

Never conflate marketplace Name with backend `modelName`.

---

## SecretVM flow (preferred — fewest surprises)

Restarts you should expect:

1. **Start VM** with placeholder `WEB_PUBLIC_URL` → learn hostname → **re-paste secrets** → restart
2. **Connect + register** provider (wallet must already hold **MOR + ETH** on Base)
3. **Add models/backends** → update `MODELS_CONFIG_CONTENT` → **re-paste secrets** → restart → **place bids** (~0.3 MOR fee each)

### Step 1 — Wallet & node

- Fund wallet: ≥ ~0.2 MOR stake + 0.3 MOR per bid + ETH gas ([networks](https://nodedocs.mor.org/get-started/networks-and-tokens))
- Fill `WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY`, `ETH_NODE_ADDRESS` (Alchemy/Infura), `COOKIE_CONTENT`
- `MODELS_CONFIG` may be `{"models":[]}` until step 3
- Save/load `morpheus-provider-secrets.json` on disk for later edits

### Step 2 — Deploy VM

- Fetch digest-pinned `docker-compose.tee.deployed.yml` (never `:latest`)
- Portal: https://secretai.scrtlabs.com/secret-vms/create
- Paste compose + 5 secrets → start → set `WEB_PUBLIC_URL` → re-paste → healthcheck
- Connect MyProvider → register `host:3333`

### Step 3 — Models & bids

- Look up Ids on https://active.mor.org — prefer existing
- Bid in **MOR/hour** (tooling converts to wei/sec)
- Per bid: Own backend **or** Use Venice → pick Venice model id from live catalog → API key once, reuse on later Venice bids
- Copy updated secrets → update VM → restart → place bids in MyProvider

Venice is a **backend choice per bid**, not a deploy path. https://nodedocs.mor.org/providers/resale/reselling-venice

---

## Other deploy paths

Container / Release / GitHub will follow the same node-first order once SecretVM is tuned. Docs:

| Path | Docs |
|------|------|
| Container | https://nodedocs.mor.org/providers/full/proxy-router-docker |
| Release | https://nodedocs.mor.org/providers/full/quickstart |
| GitHub | https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/Morpheus-Lumerin-Node |

---

## Auth model

| Surface | Auth |
|---------|------|
| MyProvider → your node | HTTP Basic Auth (COOKIE_CONTENT) |
| Consumers → `:3333` | Morpheus session / marketplace |
| Hosted Inference API | api.mor.org — **different product** |

---

## Common mistakes

- Putting full MODELS_CONFIG before the VM hostname exists (extra restarts)
- Conflating Morpheus Name with Venice/local `modelName`
- Asking for wei/sec — use MOR/hour
- MetaMask with MyProvider — use node Basic Auth
- Bidding before backend/config works — burns 0.3 MOR
- Tagging Venice as `tee`
- Using `:latest` instead of digest-pinned compose
- Unfunded wallet (no MOR/ETH) before register/bid
